items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father was well known around the area.

ctx.x: What was your father like and what was your mother like?
My father was well known around the area. He was an exemplary... He was known as somebody that was nice to the blacks. He dealt with them...
I remember that he put plumbing into the manager’s house, and a lot of people around there thought that was a bold move, that they might have to do the same or something like that.
